sentences.text: Nagatitan was a massive sauropod whose overall body length was calculated to be about 27.2 meters.
The fossil material was uncovered in 2016 by Thanom Luangnan in Chaiyaphum province, Thailand.
It belongs to the euhelopodid macronarian sauropods, a group within the larger clade of long-necked dinosaurs.
Phylogenetic analysis placed it inside the family Euhelopodidae.
When characters were weighted equally, Nagatitan emerged as the sister taxon to the European genus Europatitan at the base of Euhelopodidae.
It lived during the Early Cretaceous Aptian to Albian ages, between 121.4 and 100.5 million years ago.
Its remains come from the Khok Kruat Formation of Thailand.
